nodes.label: Frozen Actual Target, Specification, Abstraction and Cell Coverage
nodes.statement: A universal-range claim fixes one predeclared actual target T, bearer/time/sort/realization identity, a specification range S, an actual-to-specification abstraction alpha with explicit grounding assumptions, and a coverage predicate Cov requiring a valid R170 cell with matching R169 route/channel evidence; abstract membership and actual coverage are not identified.
nodes.domain: One R170 target and one proposed hardware/program/sensorimotor/biological specification.
nodes.scope: One R170 target and one proposed hardware/program/sensorimotor/biological specification.
nodes.source_lineage: R170 target/cell contract plus UCT-I physical-witness discipline, refined by standard abstraction/refinement typing.
nodes.proof: Contract definition; direct and inductive routes below discharge different universal quantifiers.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A finite or well-typed abstract S may omit actual modes or merge fibers with different route radii.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: actual target contexts, abstract states, abstraction/refinement evidence and route cells
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: every actual context claimed by the selected proof route
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same frozen R169-R170 bearer lineage, consumer, interval, sort and realization identity
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Prevent abstract specification range from being confused with actual physical coverage

nodes.label: Total Grounding, Universal Inclusion and Fiber Coverage
nodes.statement: A direct certificate requires alpha to be defined for every z in the frozen actual target T, proves alpha(z) in S for every z in T by a structural argument, and proves every actual fiber represented in S has a valid R170 cell/route coverage witness.
nodes.domain: One actual target T, specification S and universal fiber-to-cell family.
nodes.scope: One actual target T, specification S and universal fiber-to-cell family.
nodes.source_lineage: Direct total-range discharge of R170-G2/G7 using actual grounding and universal cell coverage.
nodes.proof: The certificate packages D1-D3; its closure implication is the next node.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Enumeration of S alone establishes neither total actual grounding nor universal actual fiber coverage.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: all actual target contexts, their specification images and actual fibers
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: forall z in T before outcomes
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same target identity and route evidence on every fiber
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Supply a direct proof route to empty the R170 remainder

nodes.label: Direct Certificate Implies T Equals Covered Domain
nodes.statement: If the common actual/specification contract and D1-D3 hold for the same R170 target, then every z in T is in a certified cell, so C=T and U is empty relative to that target.
nodes.domain: One common R170 target and valid direct certificate.
nodes.scope: One common R170 target and valid direct certificate.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary arbitrary-element inclusion typed to R170's C/U partition.
nodes.proof: For arbitrary z in T, universal inclusion gives alpha(z) in S and fiber coverage gives Cov(z), hence z in C; therefore T subseteq C, while C subseteq T by definition.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The result is only as strong as the actual target, total grounding and fiber certificate; it is not complete-mechanism proof.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: actual target and certified covered domain
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: every actual z in the same predeclared T
formal_contract_R171.purpose: State exactly when a direct structural proof removes the open-world remainder

nodes.label: Initial, Closure, Actual Refinement and Fiber Coverage
nodes.statement: For a target defined exactly as Reach(I,W,R_act), an inductive certificate requires actual initial inclusion, specification closure under every admissible input/nondeterministic or hybrid mode, forward simulation of every actual transition, and universal invariant-fiber R170 cell coverage.
nodes.domain: One frozen actual transition protocol, abstract transition system and invariant range.
nodes.scope: One frozen actual transition protocol, abstract transition system and invariant range.
nodes.source_lineage: Standard inductive invariant and forward-simulation proof form applied to R170 actual cell coverage.
nodes.proof: The certificate packages I1-I5; the induction implication is the next node.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: It certifies only the frozen reachable target, not all physically possible contexts or a larger complete organization.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: actual and specification transition systems, inputs/modes, invariant and route cells
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: every finite actual execution path and every admissible input/mode
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same bearer lineage, protocol, realization, abstraction and route evidence
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Supply a protocol-relative inductive proof route to empty the R170 remainder

nodes.label: Inductive Certificate Covers Every Protocol-Reachable Context
nodes.statement: If I1-I5 hold on one actual/specification pair, induction on path length gives Reach(I,W,R_act) subseteq C, so U is empty for the exactly declared protocol-relative target and no broader target.
nodes.domain: One common protocol-relative target and valid inductive certificate.
nodes.scope: One common protocol-relative target and valid inductive certificate.
nodes.source_lineage: Established invariant induction and forward simulation, with actual fiber coverage appended.
nodes.proof: Initial inclusion is the base; actual refinement plus specification closure is the step for every admissible mode; invariant fiber coverage places every reachable context in C.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Changing controller, environment, horizon, input/mode set or realization changes the target and requires a new certificate.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: protocol-reachable actual contexts and certified cells
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: all finite path lengths, all admissible inputs/modes and all nondeterministic successors
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same actual/specification pair and frozen protocol scope
formal_contract_R171.purpose: State exactly when an inductive proof removes the protocol-relative remainder

nodes.label: Initial, Closure, Refinement and Fiber Clauses Cannot Be Silently Dropped
nodes.statement: Four two-state deterministic systems show separately that omitting initial inclusion, specification closure, actual refinement or invariant fiber coverage allows the remaining three clauses to hold while an actual reachable state remains uncovered.
nodes.domain: Finite deterministic actual/model transition systems with one input.
nodes.scope: Finite deterministic actual/model transition systems with one input.
nodes.source_lineage: Project-specific exact countermodels for the standard induction/refinement premise package.
nodes.proof: Each saved witness satisfies exactly three obligations, falsifies the named fourth and reaches a state outside C.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Stronger domain-specific premises may imply one clause; the witnesses establish independence in the general contract.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: two-state transition systems and obligation truth values
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: one explicit witness per omitted general premise
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: abstract finite logical models only, not actual apparatus
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Expose hidden premise loss in universal-range arguments

nodes.label: Successful Proper Samples Cannot Prove Universal Coverage
nodes.statement: For every proper observed subset F of a target T, there are two worlds identical on F, one fully covered and one with an uncovered z* in T\F; therefore finite fit, density or challenge success on F does not entail T subseteq C.
nodes.domain: Any finite or infinite target with a proper observed subset.
nodes.scope: Any finite or infinite target with a proper observed subset.
nodes.source_lineage: Elementary indistinguishable-world countermodel extending R170's finite-challenge incompleteness.
nodes.proof: Choose z* outside F; keep both worlds equal on F and change only Cov(z*).
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Exhaustive enumeration can work only after completeness of the actual target enumeration and every fiber coverage clause are proved.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: target, proper sample and coverage predicate
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same target identity; observation restricted to F
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Separate universal proof from fitted or sample-only coverage

nodes.label: Hardware, Program, Sensorimotor and Biological Obligations
nodes.statement: Finite hardware needs deployed-realization/reset/input/mode and fiber coverage; typed programs need semantics/type preservation plus compiler/runtime/FFI/environment refinement; sensorimotor ranges need physical limits, complete hybrid modes, interval/reachability and model-error bounds; biological envelopes need population admission, uncertainty/disturbance, controlled invariance, monitoring/actuation/failsafe and fiber coverage.
nodes.domain: Four named domain families under the common R171 certificate contract.
nodes.scope: Four named domain families under the common R171 certificate contract.
nodes.source_lineage: Standard domain proof obligations mapped into the R169-R171 actual route/range contract.
nodes.proof: Each application must select either the direct or inductive route and discharge the listed actuality and scope clauses; no family name itself proves them.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Bit width, type safety, learned manifolds and nominal barriers can each remain specification-only.

formal_contract_R171.object_domain: four application families and their actual realizations
formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: every premise required by the selected direct or inductive route
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: domain-specific but bound to one actual R170 target each
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Make the next physical proof obligations falsifiable and domain-specific

nodes.label: Invalid, Refuted, Direct, Reachable, Specification, Empirical or Unresolved
nodes.statement: Invalid target/identity/semantics/safety typing gives INVALID_RANGE_PROTOCOL; a valid obligation violation gives RANGE_CERTIFICATE_REFUTED; proved D1-D3 gives UNIVERSAL_RANGE_CERTIFIED_DIRECT; proved I1-I5 gives UNIVERSAL_RANGE_CERTIFIED_REACHABLE; abstract closure without actual grounding/refinement/fiber gives SPECIFICATION_ONLY; finite fit/sample support gives EMPIRICAL_COVER_ONLY; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
nodes.domain: One frozen universal-range claim and its evidence package.
nodes.scope: One frozen universal-range claim and its evidence package.
nodes.source_lineage: R170 coverage triage refined by direct/inductive proof-route and evidence-level distinctions.
nodes.proof: Priority logic is exhaustively checked over 64 Boolean assignments; certification retains its exact target scope.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Specification-only and empirical-only are evidence classifications, not claims of absence or failed C1.

formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: validity first, refutation second, exact proof routes next, evidence-only states after
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same target, realization, semantics, cell family and validity event
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Prevent an abstract or fitted cover from being reported as actual universal range

nodes.label: Universal Range Refines R170 Coverage Only
nodes.statement: If the full R170 application and one valid R171 direct or inductive certificate hold on the same actual target, the corresponding U-empty coverage conclusion may be used exactly within that scope; no result establishes complete organization, derives C1 or B_min, makes range certification necessary for basal experience or selects an exclusive owner.
nodes.domain: One common actual R166-R171 episode, target and certificate package.
nodes.scope: One common actual R166-R171 episode, target and certificate package.
nodes.source_lineage: Conditional refinement of R170's application boundary with UCT-I physical-witness and self/owner limits retained.
nodes.proof: Bind the selected certificate route and R170 objects to one actual target; apply only its scope and preserve all semantic boundaries.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Separately closed program, device or body subsystems need not compose into one closed complete organization.

formal_contract_R171.quantifiers: all simultaneous premises on one target; no necessity or semantic conclusion
formal_contract_R171.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D/rho lineage, target, abstraction/refinement, consumer and interval
formal_contract_R171.purpose: Advance actual-organization coverage without turning formal verification into an experience gate

rules.statement: The common target/specification contract and every D1-D3 premise jointly imply direct actual coverage closure.
rules.proof_sketch: Apply universal inclusion and fiber coverage to arbitrary z in T.

rules.statement: The exact reachable target, initial inclusion, all-mode closure, actual refinement and invariant fiber coverage jointly imply protocol-relative coverage closure.
rules.proof_sketch: Induct on actual path length and then apply fiber coverage.

formal_contract_R171.quantification: all finite paths and admissible successors

rules.statement: The finite-challenge boundary and exact missing-premise witnesses jointly support the proper-sample non-entailment result.
rules.proof_sketch: Construct closed and open worlds equal on the proper sample and differing at one unobserved target.

bindings_required: no structural universal premise imported from fit

rules.statement: The two valid closure routes and fitted-cover obstruction jointly delimit the hardware, program, sensorimotor and biological proof obligations.
rules.proof_sketch: For each family select one closure route, instantiate every premise and reject sample/specification-only substitutes.

formal_contract_R171.quantification: every premise in the chosen family instantiation

rules.statement: The target/specification contract, both proof routes and the exact countermodel boundaries jointly require seven-way range-evidence status logic.
rules.proof_sketch: Prioritize invalidity and refutation, then exact direct/reachable certification, then specification/empirical evidence levels, else unresolved.

rules.statement: The full R170 application, exact closure routes, domain scopes and triage jointly permit only the selected target-relative range conclusion while preserving all experiential boundaries.
rules.proof_sketch: Bind all objects to one target, use one actually discharged closure route, and block reverse inference to complete organization, C1, B_min, basal experience or an exclusive owner.
